# Day Drawing

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

An Obsidian Excalidraw drawing note with an infinite drawing space, tools, and plugins. embedded Base views, Dataview, and Datacore queries for a day.

## Scope note

Visually organize and layout notes, groups, and relationships, along with images, links, etc.
